minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  MAY 11, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  May 11, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, May 26, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Chair Peterson, Kaviani, Rubincam and
  Wade

  Members absent: Chooljian

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

NEW BUSINESS

1.  Presentation and discussion relating to the safety trimming and removal of trees at
  the entrance to the city from Torrance on Palos Verdes Drive West

Received and filed

CITIZEN APPLICATION

2.  PC-392-15; Application to retain trees, vegetation and non-standard
  encroachments located in the Parklands adjacent to 990 Paseo La Cresta

  Applicant:  Jason Moskowitz
  990 Paseo La Cresta
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Continued for 90 days at the request of the applicant. A survey is required to be
submitted on or before June 22, 2015.
 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 26, 2015
  Directors initials SR-L
 3.  PC-393-15; Application to remove 1 American Elm tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 565 Via Almar

  Applicant:  Bill Lahey
  568 Via Almar
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Rubincam motioned and seconded by Wade to approve
the removal of 1 American Elm tree including the stump located in the parkway
adjacent to 565 Via Almar according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal
Approvals’. The vote was 4-0-1, Chooljian absent. A payment of $500 to the ‘Tree
Bank’ is required. The Committee directed staff to plant 1 new Little Gem
Magnolia, the ‘Designated Street Tree’ at 565 Via Almar.

4.  PC-394-15; Application to plant trees in the Cataluna Parklands strip located at
  the rear of 1616 Cataluna Place

  Applicant:  Alexandra Bolinder-Gibsand
  1616 Cataluna Place
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Wade motioned and seconded by Kaviani to approve
the planting of two trees in the Cataluna Parklands Strip located adjacent to 1616
Cataluna place. The vote was 4-0-1, Chooljian absent. The architect, Rainville
Design, to work with the Forester to select the species of native trees.

5.  PC-395-15; Application to remove 1 American Elm located in the parkway
  adjacent to 421 Via Almar

  Applicant:  John and Liz Marushin
  424 Via Almar
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Kaviani motioned and seconded by Wade to approve
the removal of 1 American Elm including the stump located adjacent to 421 Via
Almar according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. The
vote was 4-0-1, Chooljian absent. A payment of $500 to the ‘Tree Bank’ is required.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 26, 2015
  Directors initials SR-L
 6.  PC-396-15; Application to remove 2 Olive trees located in the parkway adjacent
  to 933 Via Rincon

  Applicant:  Daniel O. Booker
  1443 Via Castilla
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Continued to the next meeting to allow the applicant to obtain a doctor’s note
indicating the allergy conditions of the children.

7.  PC-397-15; Application to remove 1 Aleppo pine tree located in the parkway
  adjacent to 3301 Via La Selva

  Applicant:  Jeff Aleixo
  3301 Via La Selva
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Wade motioned and seconded by Kaviani to deny the
application. The vote was 4-0-1, Chooljian absent.

OLD BUSINESS

None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

8.  Update on current applications

Received and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, May 26, 2015
  Directors initials SR-L
